name: dsh-plugin-vajraclaw
description: Local tool-call failsafe and DWGR-8 personal governance proxy gate for DSH: blocks high-risk shell patterns, credential leaks, and enforces declarative param-level boundaries with hash-linked JSONL audit logs and optional Gateway.
author: Top-Celestial Company Ltd. / Jimmy Chen <service@dr-os.io>

dsh.displayName: DROS™ VajraClaw - Local Tool Failsafe & Personal Gate
dsh.description: Local tool-call failsafe and DWGR-8 personal governance gate for DSH with regex pattern blocking, param-level path traversal defense, hash-linked JSONL audit log, and optional external Gateway support.

enableEmbeddedEngine.title: Enable Embedded Failsafe Engine
enableEmbeddedEngine.description: Enable zero-latency local pattern failsafe for high-risk shell commands and credential files.

personalConfigFile.title: DROS Personal Config File Path
personalConfigFile.description: Path to local declarative DWGR-8 governance configuration file for action-level and param-level constraints.

strictFailClosed.title: Strict Fail-Closed Mode
strictFailClosed.description: When false (default), fallback gracefully to embedded local engine if external Gateway is unreachable.

gatewayUrl.title: DROS Gateway Endpoint
gatewayUrl.description: Optional URL for external DROS Gateway. Default is empty (disabled).

licenseKey.title: Gumroad Commercial License Key
licenseKey.description: Optional commercial license key for enterprise cluster scaling.
